explanation: The 2020-03-15 document contains an extraordinary concentration of substantive policy actions: an emergency rate cut to 0-1/4 percent (effectively the zero lower bound), a new large-scale asset purchase program of at least $500B in Treasuries and $200B in agency MBS, expanded repo operations, forward guidance tying rate lift-off to economic recovery from COVID-19, and explicit crisis acknowledgment of severely strained Treasury, credit, and funding markets. These actions collectively represent a full-scale policy regime shift that directly explains a structural break in financial market data around March 12, 2020, as markets were pricing in these emergency measures and reacting to the acute liquidity dislocations described in the document.
